title: Media Prima Audio Trade Show 2025 — Radio Packages
summary: 30-second radio packages from 1 to 26 weeks: Hot FM RM27k–RM468k, Fly/eight FM RM14k–RM182k, Molek RM6.5k–RM91k, Kool 101 RM9k–RM104k; Sabah/Sarawak RM11.5k–RM195k.
description: Media Prima Audio trade-show 2025 booking form covering Hot FM, Kool 101, Molek FM, Fly FM, eight FM and Kool 101 Sabah/Sarawak. All packages use 30-second commercials with 70/280/910/1,820 spots over 1/4/13/26 weeks. Hot FM RM27,000–468,000; Kool 101 RM9,000–104,000; Molek FM RM6,500–91,000; Fly FM and eight FM RM14,000–182,000; Kool 101 Sabah RM12,500–195,000; Kool 101 Sarawak RM11,500–176,800. Four-week packages include commercial production and VO talent; 13- and 26-week packages add social videos, video production and AI jingle production (Sabah/Sarawak exclude AI jingle). Bookings valid until 31 Dec 2025 with utilisation by 30 Jun 2026. Production buyout RM1,550; jingle buyout RM10,000 per version. Malay-station blackout 16 Feb–29 Mar 2026; Sabah/Sarawak blackout 1 May–30 Jun 2026. Rates exclude 8% SST.
validity: Book by 31 Dec 2025; utilise by 30 Jun 2026
